title: SpecSearch: Towards Hardware-Aware Efficient Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.22296v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) inference, but its optimal configuration depends jointly on workload characteristics, GPU hardware, and available memory. For example, on the RTX~5090, the state-of-the-art speculative drafter DFlash achieves $3.50\times$ the throughput of autoregressive (AR) decoding at low concurrency, but only $0.76\times$ at high concurrency with short outputs. We present SpecSearch, a hardware-aware search engine that jointly optimizes decoding strategy, draft length, and precision across workload--GPU pairs. Its analytical cost model captures memory and compute constraints to identify feasible configurations and narrow the search space for throughput optimization. Guided by this model, calibration measurements are collected from multiple GPUs. Using the measurements, a Jev-based predictor learns to select high-throughput decoding configurations on held-out GPUs without requiring deplo

translated_title: SpecSearch：迈向硬件感知的高效推测解码
translated_abstract: 推测解码（SD）可以加速大语言模型（LLM）的推理，但其最优配置同时取决于工作负载特性、GPU硬件和可用内存。例如，在RTX 5090上，最先进的推测起草器DFlash在低并发情况下可实现自回归（AR）解码3.50倍的吞吐量，但在高并发且输出较短的情况下仅为0.76倍。我们提出了SpecSearch，这是一个硬件感知的搜索引擎，可在不同工作负载-GPU组合上联合优化解码策略、草稿长度和精度。其分析成本模型捕捉内存与计算约束，以识别可行配置并缩小吞吐量优化的搜索空间。在该模型的指导下，从多个GPU上收集校准测量数据。利用这些测量数据，基于Jev的预测器学习在未见过的GPU上选择高吞吐量的解码配置，而无需进行部署……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出硬件感知搜索引擎SpecSearch，通过分析成本模型与基于校准数据的预测器，在不同工作负载与GPU组合上联合优化解码策略、草稿长度和精度，自动选择高吞吐量的推测解码配置。
en_tdlr: We present SpecSearch, a hardware-aware search engine that leverages an analytical cost model and calibration-based prediction to jointly optimize decoding strategy, draft length, and precision across workload-GPU pairs, enabling high-throughput speculative decoding configurations on unseen GPUs.
